handoff.objective: Audit the v3 two-stage contraction, exact backend, shape census, and numeric resource gates before source implementation.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the revised operation equations, mandatory counts, int64 bound, peak liveness, cumulative ceilings, and B^5 comparator are arithmetically correct and complete.
constraints: Recompute all displayed formulas and counts independently.
Include allocation temporaries and complete two-sweep work.
Treat aggregate ceilings as invalidation gates, not performance evidence.
Keep verifier enumeration separate from producer preprocessing.
completion_gate: Every dot-product bound is safe under the pinned backend.
Per-object and cumulative gates cover all declared phases.
No comparator can be read as a speedup claim.
handoff.return_format: Use the repository handoff headings and end with one next concrete action.
